Stay A While Studio · ARC 818 · Baze University, Abuja

The Professor's Room, between two blues

Classroom B16 in Block B, turned into a bedroom suite for Prof. Willem Adewale and laid out like a game of chess. Turn the 3D model, take the walkthrough through the renders, or stand in the room and look around.

Building the room…
Drag to turn the room · scroll or pinch to zoom
Move I · at the door

The opening

A linen sofa under an indigo Adire panel, a rattan pendant, an iroko coffee table and a cane console. Bright and open for students who drop by.

Move II · at the windows

The middlegame

An iroko desk, a window seat, and a chess table whose top turns over into an Ayò board. A 4.2 m library wall with a ladder runs along the corridor side.

Move III · on the old dais

The endgame

The bed on a 235 mm iroko podium under a slatted canopy, an Adire headboard, a chalk thinking wall, and a Delft-tiled en-suite in the corner.
